subject: Demo availability — vendor intake & SSO questionnaire gating
messages:
From: Alyson Park <alyson.park@healthsync.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@healthsync.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo — next steps before live walkthrough

Hi Jonas / Laura,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier. Procurement got back to our security team and flagged two gating items they want closed before a formal product demo: the vendor intake questionnaire (attached), and SSO integration details (SAML metadata / assertion flow). They also want a copy of your latest SOC2 report and a short list of data retention practices.

Because of that, they asked us to pause the public demo until the intake is completed and approved by our InfoSec team. I know this is annoying — we're still excited to see the product — but procurement typically won't allow a demo that touches any production-like data until vendor clearance is finished.

I've attached the vendor questionnaire (filled with a few initial answers from our side) and copied our procurement lead Ravi. Can you confirm whether you can provide a SAML metadata endpoint and an editable questionnaire response (PDF/Word) so our team can review?

Attachment: healthsync_vendor_questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Best,
Alyson Park
Director, Platform Operations
HealthSync
alyson.park@healthsync.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alyson Park <alyson.park@healthsync.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo — next steps before live walkthrough

Alyson — thanks for the heads up and for sending the questionnaire. We can absolutely walk through the SAML metadata and provide SOC2; happy to share a sanitized copy of our latest report and a short vendor security summary.

Priya (SE) — looping you in to help fill the intake answers and prepare a lightweight pre-demo checklist. Karthik (Infosec) — could you flag anything in the questionnaire that will block an internal approval? If we can fill the form and provide SAML metadata by early next week, would that be enough for procurement to clear the demo?

We recommend keeping the originally booked demo slot tentatively on the calendar but marking it "pending vendor approval". If procurement expects a longer approval horizon, we can propose alternative dates. I attached our short demo deck so your stakeholders can review product scope while intake is processed.

Attachment: redwood_demo-deck.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB)

Proposed next steps:
- HealthSync to confirm procurement intake deadline (Alyson / Ravi)
- Redwood to return completed questionnaire & SAML metadata by EOD Monday
- If vendor cleared, confirm demo window; otherwise propose tentative roll to week of Dec 14

Thanks — talk soon.

— Jonas Webber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Alyson Park <alyson.park@healthsync.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@healthsync.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 15:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo — next steps before live walkthrough

Thanks Jonas — quick update from procurement: they want the questionnaire fully answered and SSO metadata uploaded into our vendor portal before they'll grant demo access. They told us the earliest likely approval date is Dec 13 (our vendor intake queue is pretty backed up this month).

We can definitely accept the demo deck in the meantime; procurement also asked whether Redwood supports SAML 2.0 with IdP-initiated flows and whether you offer a test tenant that can be used without production data during a walkthrough. If you can provide an editable copy of the questionnaire (Word preferred) and SAML metadata, we'll push to get this queued.

Alyson

Cc: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 16:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo — next steps before live walkthrough

Alyson / team — thanks for the clarity and for routing the questionnaire. We've reviewed the ask internally. Karthik: can you confirm the SAML metadata payload format we typically provide and whether there are any known items on the questionnaire that will require legal review?

Per Jonas' suggestion, let's move the live demo to follow procurement's likely approval date. Can we tentatively book a demo for Tuesday, Dec 14 at 10:00 AM PT, pending your vendor clearance? If procurement confirms earlier, we can expedite.

We will:
- Return the questionnaire as an editable Word document (Priya will own)
- Send SAML metadata + test tenant credentials to your security team
- Share a redacted SOC2 summary and data retention note for procurement review

Alyson — appreciate if Ravi can confirm whether Dec 14 looks feasible on your side. We'll hold the calendar tentatively and mark it "pending intake approval." If procurement requires a different cadence, we'll adapt.

Related: https://hubspot.company/contacts/HS-4821 | Drive assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-demo-assets

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
